headline: 6 types of synovial joints
body:
Hinge: elbow, knee, ankle
Pivot: C1–C2, proximal radioulnar
Condyloid: wrist, knuckles (MCP)
Saddle: base of the thumb (CMC)
Plane: intercarpal, AC joint
Ball-and-socket: shoulder, hip
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology, 9.4 Synovial Joints

headline: Parts of the nephron in order
body:
1. Glomerulus + Bowman's capsule
2. Proximal convoluted tubule
3. Loop of Henle: down, then up
4. Distal convoluted tubule
Next: collecting duct (past the nephron)
source: Source: Lumen Learning A&P, Nephrons – Structure
